stage: Evidence-Triggered Baseline Hold — BNR 2025 Financial-Accounts Topology Trigger
purpose: Record a newly identified official BNR/CMFB financial-accounts structural-metadata source that satisfies the changed-dataset-topology/new-official-source condition narrowly enough to reopen one public-access/source-topology recovery pass, while preserving all numerical, accounting, reference-mode and behavioural promotion gates.

evidence.reporting_framework: CMFB level-3 national quality/structural-metadata report for financial accounts
newly_identified_clues: The last major benchmark revision of national financial accounts was completed in April 2025.
A new financial-accounts IT system has been in place since mid-2025.
Quarterly data extend from 1995Q1 and annual data are compiled from quarterly data for all available series.
National financial accounts are prepared on a who-to-whom basis with sector, financial-instrument and counterpart dimensions used in compilation and consistency checks.
All sectors are disseminated quarterly and annually for stocks and flows, while regular OECD transmission of all financial-accounts datasets began in April 2025.

trigger_adjudication.declared_condition: Changed official ECB/Eurostat/BNR/OECD dataset topology or a new official source supplies evidence relevant to the frozen sector/instrument/frequency/counterpart boundary.
